<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="XdDcmusgJa7BjE8ih_qE"> <mxGraphModel dx="2553" dy="1513" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" background="light-dark(#FFFFFF,#121212)" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "
@startuml
title SecPipe Prototype 1 - Implemented Demo Scan

autoactivate on

actor User

participant \"SecPipe CLI\" as CLI
participant \"DemoScan\" as Demo
participant \"DemoSqliDetector\" as Detector
participant \"JavaParser\" as Parser
participant \"ContractJson\" as JSON
participant \"SchemaRegistry\" as Schema
participant \"DemoReport\" as Report

User -> CLI: Run scan command
CLI -> CLI: Parse arguments\nValidate target directory

CLI -> Demo: run(root, targetLabel, outPath)

Demo -> Detector: scan(target)

Detector -> Detector: Find and sort *.java files

loop For each Java file
 Detector -> Parser: parse(file contents)
 Parser --> Detector: ParseResult

 alt Parse successful
 Detector -> Detector: Find MethodCallExpr nodes

 loop For each method call
 Detector -> Detector: check(file, call)
 Detector -> Detector: Check JDBC sink name
 Detector -> Detector: Check SQL argument\nfor non-literal concatenation

 opt Matching concatenation found
 Detector -> Detector: Create SqliHit
 end
 end
 else Parse failed
 Detector -> Detector: Increment skipped count
 end
end

Detector -> Detector: Sort hits
Detector --> Demo: Result(hits, filesParsed, filesSkipped)

Demo -> Demo: toFindings(hits)
Demo -> Demo: Create output directory

Demo -> JSON: writeFindings(findingsFile, findings)
JSON --> Demo: Write findings.json

Demo -> Demo: Read findings.json
Demo -> Schema: validate(findings.schema.json, json)
Schema --> Demo: ValidationResult

Demo -> Report: render(targetLabel, result, findings)
Report -> Report: Build Markdown report\nSeverity counts and finding details
Report --> Demo: Markdown report

Demo -> Demo: Write report.md

Demo --> CLI: Outcome(findings, hits, validation,\nfile counts and output paths)

alt Schema validation fails
 CLI -> User: Display validation error
else Schema validation succeeds
 CLI -> User: Display finding count and output paths
 CLI -> User: Display top findings

 opt --fail-on-needs-validation and findings exist
 CLI -> CLI: Return EXIT_FINDINGS
 end
end

@enduml
